title: Giants vs. Rams: Listen Live to Monday Night Football on SiriusXM
summary: Catch every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
Listen live as the[New York Giants](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/new-york-giants) and[Los Angeles Rams](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/los-angeles-rams) face off on[Monday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/monday-night-football-schedule-listen) during Week 2 of the 2026 NFL regular season live on SiriusXM on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk2-GiantsRams) .


[Giants vs. Rams Today • 8:15PM ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk2-GiantsRams)


The Giants visit the Rams on Monday, September 21 at 8:15pm ET from SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.


### How to Listen to Giants vs. Rams


**Date:** Monday, September 21
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** SoFi Stadium, Inglewood, California


**Broncos broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 823 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk2-GiantsRams) )
**Chiefs broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 818 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk2-GiantsRams) )
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio)
**Spanish-language broadcast:** Ch. 194 (car), Ch. 832 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk2-GiantsRams) )


### Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the SiriusXM app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup. Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios.


The schedule of games airing on SiriusXM for Week 1 is available here:[SiriusXM.com/Sports](http://www.siriusxm.com/sports) .


Listeners can access NFL game broadcasts and the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel with SiriusXM’s most popular subscription plans, including Platinum, All Access and Music & Entertainment, as well as SiriusXM’s sports-focused subscription plan,[SiriusXM Sports Pass](http://www.siriusxm.com/siriusxmsportspass) , priced at $5 per month.
